text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pocket-senpai, happy birthday. It's 
modest, but it's a token of my everyday 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! This is that thing they showed on 
TV, right? Heh heh, I've been dyin' to try 
it~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The baked goods set from the sweets shop 
by the station— especially the muscat 
financier—is quite popular. I do hope it 
suits your taste..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Mm, guess I'll dig right in.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“—No, I mean you! You! I'm saying let's go 
eat together, right now!”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ah, no, but... This is purely a 
gift for Pocket-senpai, so I—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's not something you gotta worry 
about, I mean... I just wanted to— ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Look, what I'm trying to say is, y'know! 
If you're gonna celebrate, you might as 
well celebrate all the way through!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Indeed, sitting around a table 
together certainly makes it feel like a 
proper birthday party."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Then please, let me join you. I'll prepare 
tea and food... and celebrate with all my 
heart...!
